blocks.text: Iron tests measure different substances in blood to check iron levels in the body. Iron is needed to make hemoglobin, a protein in red blood cells that carries oxygen.
Types of iron tests include serum iron, transferrin, total iron-binding capacity, and ferritin blood tests.
The amount of iron in blood varies throughout the day and may be higher in the morning.

title: Iron Tests
